searchText: Next time we can try to decide those changes it a bit earlier 🙂 Either way, https://blog.ethereum.org/2026/09/17/glamsterdam-testnet-announcement has the info on how to set it up for Teku and Prysm. For Sepolia, it is also safe to run Teku develop if anyone wants the new default set as part of the schedule. Does it really have to be part of the release? It's a permissioned validator set anyway. Node operators could just override it it would have been nice to the schedule in action on a public testnet that’s it I wouldn't be surprised if we see pre-fork gas limit bump if operators set this via flag
